description:
How do we know what God's will for our lives is? Pastor John Lomacang will help us to understand along with other viewer questions and answers provided by John Dinzey, Daniel Perrin, and hosted by Angela Lomacang.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. What is the Greek word for bread used "that night when Jesus took bread in Corinthians" and also the Greek word used for bread the night before He died. It was not yet the feast of unleavened bread so I'm thinking it was leavened bread. Could you please clarify for me? What kind of bread does it say in Greek? 

2. What will happen to the Holy Ghost, who flows freely here on Earth, when the saints are taken to Heaven? Will He accompany them or will He remain here on earth? 

3. I heard a worship leader say that Jesus choose to "imprison" himself in a human body forever, so He's no longer omnipresent nor will He ever be again. Is this biblical truth? Did Jesus choose to imprison himself in a human body forever?

4. Why is God's name not used more often? It's really good to acknowledge Jesus all the time, however, there are numerous scriptures that states "the Father, God's people would know his name", ie Psalm 83:18 and Isaiah 52:6 

5. How can the church be the bride, the bridesmaids, and the wedding guests? 

6. Please explain Matthew 16:19? 

7. Can the 1/3 of the angels who were cast out of heaven repent and choose to give their lives back to God? 

8. Do angels still visit us like they did in Daniel's time period? I've had waking dreams and Visions of Life-threatening events that happened the next day. Was God trying to warn me? Does God do that? 

9. How do you receive the Holy Spirit? 

10. What are the seven horns in Revelation 5:6?

11. Who is the prince in Ezekiel 46? 

12.  I would like to know what God's will for my life is? Please give me understanding. How do I know God's will for my life?
